sourceSteps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。

reviewObservation: Hip-hinge back nearly horizontal, knees softly bent, feet and pelvis fixed; both dumbbells below chest at start, both arms open laterally into shoulder-level wide T at end, slight elbow bend retained, no elbow curl. Head/neck and tail remain stable. First start was too upright and rejected privately.

rejectedStart.reason: Torso too upright, neck looking forward instead of hip-hinge neutral neck.
